description: This file represents an Android activity class called OrderConfirmationActivity which displays an order confirmation screen after a successful checkout. It handles UI initialization, populates order details, and sets a result for the calling activity.

classes.name: OrderConfirmationActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays a confirmation message after an order has been successfully placed, including order details and navigation options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, retrieves intent extras, and configures navigation and result data.
